name: Rancho Santana
positioning: Beach and surf resort and residential community on Nicaragua's Emerald Coast, with stays ranging from a boutique inn to private ocean-view homes
best_for: Surfers of every level, from beginners at Playa Los Perros to the left point break at Playa Rosada
Families and groups wanting multi-bedroom condos, suites or private homes

facts.text: Rancho Santana is set across 2,700 acres of Nicaragua's Emerald Coast.
Guests have access to five beaches.
There are three surf beaches on the property: Playa Los Perros, Playa Santana and Playa Rosada.
Playa Los Perros offers approachable waves and is home to the resort's Surf Shop, lessons and rentals.
Rancho Santana offers surf lessons, professional coaching, guided surf experiences and surf-focused packages.
The Inn is Rancho Santana's boutique hotel, at the center of the resort's walkable village.
The Pacific Condos have ocean views and easy access to Playa Santana.
The Garden-View Casitas are surrounded by tropical foliage and have fully equipped kitchens.
Rancho Santana has a treetop yoga palapa.
A stay includes complimentary access to the tennis and pickleball courts, the Las Cinco Playas Tour and monkey spotting.
Stays include complimentary Kids Club access for children aged 5 to 12.
The resort's own gardens and orchards supply farm-fresh produce, served alongside locally sourced seafood and meats.

highlights.text: Playa Rosada, one of the resort's surf beaches, is known for its left point break.
Each of the Inn's rooms has a private terrace and furniture made by local artisans at the on-site woodshop.
The Spa in El Bosque is a 6,000-square-foot spa and wellness sanctuary built into the resort's rugged hillside.
The ocean-view homes range from three to nine bedrooms, with options for beachfront access and private pools.
La Casa Más Alta, one of the rental homes, sits atop seven private acres at Rancho Santana's highest point.

considerations.text: The gym, FunLimón, is across the street from Rancho Santana rather than within it.
Rancho Santana is a residential community as well as a resort, and the Pacific Condos are individually owned and decorated, so each one differs.
Stay inclusions do not apply to some special offers and group bookings.
